name: Prakash Dosa , Kalachowki
description:
Welcome to Prakash dosa ,where tradition meets taste since 1981! With three outlets, we pride ourselves on serving authentic South Indian food .From crispy dosas to flavorful idlis,vadas ,we also offer our famous frankies.
our signature dosas like Mysore masala ,Jini dosa and ghee dosas are a delight.
We offer Jain-friendly options along with our jain Chutney and Sambar, all our dosas are available in Jain variants
At Prakash dosa,we cherish the legacy born from the sheer determination of a single mother,our beloved Amma .After the tragic loss of her husband,she started this business from the ground up with three little ones by her side.
we honor Amma’s legacy by serving up authentic flavorrs ensuring quality and taste.

featured_reviews.name: Kriti Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:

Had Kolhapuri dosa and jini dosa. Loved it. If you have good spice tolerance go for it, and for jini dosa it gives a bit of fusion taste with pizza flavor.

They have introduced the filter coffee in soft serve. Ohh I went for it! And it was worth the visit.

featured_reviews.review_text: Firstly worst customer service. The person on the cash counter is least bothered in taking cooking instruction. Asked him to make dosa soft and mysore dosa less spicy. Totally worth it

featured_reviews.name: Aagam Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Authentic South Indian flavors at Beyond Idlis! Ordered the Onion Uttapam and Sada Dosa, both were absolutely delicious! featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Keyal
featured_reviews.review_text: This newly opened small restaurant in south bombay has literally won my heart with the food and service they provide. Honestly I didnt expect much but it far exceeded my expectations. I would honestly recommend you their ghee roast dosa which was soo yummy and crispy. Secondly their idli platter which had varieties of idlis in it. You cannot miss on the filter coffee whenever you visit any south indian restaurant. Looking forward to visiting here soon!

featured_reviews.name: Drashti Maniyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
An absolute value for money. The quantity was amazing and taste was quite good.
We ordered:
1. Breakfast combo- a real steal deal. a lot ot items were delivered at such a pocket friendly rate
2. onion uthappa - the taste was bomb
3. chole bhature- quite yummy chole gravy
4. pineapple sheera- my fav among all

Everything came in a good packaging.
Quite recommended!

PS- the filter coffee here is quite strong. do try if you love caffeine.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Wadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambience-5/5⭐️ Ambience is short and simple. You will get a local cafe feeling. The seatings suits the theme of the place.

Food - 5/5⭐️ This place serves a lomg range of variety in south indian dishes. Starting from their signature idlis to Authentic lemon rice. They have covered all the major dishes. We tried the following dishes.
1. Mysore Bonda 9/10
2. Panniyaram 10/10
3. Tomato Rice 10/10 (Must Try)
4. Beyond idli special Uttappa 10/10
5. Ghee Roast Dosa 10/10
6. Filter Kaafi

First of all every dish was prepared after we ordered the food thats the reason it was really tasting so fresh and delicious. We personally liked the mysore bonda and tomato rice. Also the main highlight of the this place is its price. The prices are too pocket friendly. The quality of food this place serves is really admirable. Do visit this place with your friends and family.

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Surve
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried ghee roast dosa and sandwich uttapan from Beyond Idlis. The dosa was perfectly roasted in ghee. With coconut chutney and sambar, it tasted so good. The ghee roast just enhanced the flavor. The sandwich uttapan was also tasty. Both dishes were good enough in quantity. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Let's eat Mumbai!!!
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beyond idlis is the place where you can try real south indian food!

I tried their medu wada which was crispy outside and soft inside.

Their paniyarums were so fluffy and tasted well with this spicy chutney.

The sandwich uttappa was so flavourful and fulfilling. Its a must try!

Lastly,  i tried their pav bhaji.. it was spicy. Just the way i liked!

Overall,  the cafe has delicious variety of morning breakfast!

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
South Indian food lover’s must visit Beyond Idlis located at Lower Parel. One of the best place to have south indian breakfast. Ambience is awesome. Its a sweet and small cafe❤️. We order some delicious food items from the menu…
Stuffed mirchi
Panniyaram
South Indian Thali
Beyond Idli Special Uthappa😋💯
Above mentioned dishes were very yummy and delicious. The main thing is the food was fresh and the place is very hygienic. Pricing of the dishes is unbelievable. Each and Every item starts from just Rs 50/- . Comfortable seating arrangements. The service is very good with cooperative staff.
My overall experience was the best with Beyond Idlis. Must visit with your friends, family and loved ones❤️💯
DO VISIT💯

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: The one thing I must say that this place is seriously like a heaven in terms of the south indian food. You will find many of the traditional south indian dishes as well as many of the unique dishes too. My favourite was the spot idli and the mysore masala dosa. Also the price to portion size was perfect. A must visit place if you are near lower parel railway station

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Persian Darbar in Byculla after hearing a lot of buzz around it. Given its reputation and the constant crowd outside, my expectations were naturally quite high. However, my overall experience was somewhat mixed.

To start with the positives — the ambience is genuinely good. The interiors are well done, with a spacious seating layout and a proper family-restaurant vibe. It feels grand and lively, which explains the heavy footfall. Do note that the place is almost always crowded. If you’re planning to visit, I would strongly recommend booking a table in advance or reaching a little early to avoid the long waiting time.

Coming to the food — I tried the Moroccan Kebab, Murgh Lebnani, Murgh Zafrani Tikka, Bihari Boti, and Chicken Biryani. Honestly, I found most of the dishes average. The taste and quality were mediocre, nothing extraordinary— the kind of flavour you can easily find at many other restaurants on the same street. Given the hype around the place, I expected something more distinctive or memorable. The Moroccan Kebab and Murgh variants were okay, but they didn’t stand out in terms of spice balance or uniqueness. The Bihari Boti was a bit undercooked.

The Chicken Biryani was comparatively better than the rest — flavorful, well-cooked rice, and properly spiced. It was the highlight of the meal for me.

Service, however, was quite slow — probably because of the constant rush. Staff were polite, but you’ll need some patience.

Overall, I felt the place is slightly overhyped. If you’re a hardcore foodie looking for exceptional flavours, you can skip it. If you do visit, go with limited expectations about the taste and focus more on the ambience and overall experience rather than culinary excellence.

featured_reviews.name: Atanu M
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Banana Leaf Restaurant at Palladium, Phoenix Mall. The restaurant has a pleasant ambiance with comfortable seating and a clean, well-maintained dining area. The menu offers a good selection of South Indian dishes, and the food quality was impressive. The dishes were freshly prepared, flavorful, and served in generous portions. The authentic taste and quality ingredients made the meal enjoyable, and it is evident that the kitchen puts effort into maintaining consistency.

Unfortunately, the service did not live up to the quality of the food. While the staff members were polite and courteous, the overall service was noticeably slow. From taking orders to attending to requests, there were significant delays throughout the meal. What was particularly disappointing was that we had to repeatedly ask for basic necessities such as water, extra plates, cutlery, and other table requirements. These are things that should ideally be provided proactively, especially in a restaurant located in a premium destination like Palladium, Phoenix Mall.

The restaurant has great potential because the food is genuinely good and worth recommending. However, the dining experience was affected by the lack of attentiveness and the need to constantly remind the staff about simple requests. Better coordination among the service team and a more customer-focused approach would make a substantial difference.

Overall, Banana Leaf delivers excellent food with authentic flavors, making it a good choice for South Indian cuisine lovers. However, improvements in service speed and attention to detail are needed for the experience to match the quality of the food. I would visit again for the food, but I hope the service standards improve in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Miura
featured_reviews.review_text:
As expected from such an old and iconic restaurant, the place carries a beautiful old-world charm. The crowd was immense, and we had to wait nearly 30–45 minutes for a table. Seating is shared with other guests, which adds to the authentic traditional dining experience.

What truly stood out was the remarkably quick and efficient service despite the rush. We ordered dosa and filter coffee — the dosa was absolutely delicious, especially with the generous layer of fresh white butter that elevated the taste beautifully. The filter coffee was equally excellent and perfectly satisfying.

The restaurant is quite pocket-friendly, and the staff deserves appreciation for being extremely prompt, supportive, and well-managed amidst the heavy crowd. The only downside is the waiting time and constant rush; otherwise, everything about the experience was wonderful.

featured_reviews.name: Neel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Madras is one of the most iconic South Indian restaurants in Mumbai and truly lives up to its reputation. Located in the heart of Matunga, this place is famous for serving authentic and delicious South Indian food with consistent quality for decades. The moment you enter, the aroma of fresh filter coffee, ghee, and spices creates a warm and nostalgic feeling.
I tried their famous dosa and idli, and both were excellent. The dosa was perfectly crispy with a flavorful potato filling, while the idli was soft, fresh, and served with tasty chutneys and sambhar. Their filter coffee was another highlight — strong, aromatic, and refreshing. Despite being crowded most of the time, the service is quick and efficient, which is impressive.
The restaurant maintains cleanliness and has a simple yet traditional atmosphere that adds to the experience. Prices are also reasonable considering the quality and popularity of the food. Overall, Cafe Madras is a must-visit place for anyone who loves authentic South Indian cuisine. It perfectly combines taste, tradition, and quality, making every visit memorable.
